name: benchmark_storyboard_sd21_quintet_base_multimetric
description: Five-prompt cached SD 2.1 baseline with CLIP alignment and caption keyword recall.

prompts.prompt: A black-and-white manga panel showing two teenagers facing each other on a windy rooftop at sunset, one holding a wooden staff and the other in a defensive stance, dramatic shadows and strong screentone shading
prompts.negative_prompt: blurry, low contrast, malformed hands, duplicate limbs

prompts.prompt: A manga panel inside a school library with three students around a table, one whispering, one surprised, one taking notes, tall bookshelves in the background, top-right speech bubble reserved space, crisp line art
prompts.negative_prompt: text artifacts, blurry faces, extra fingers, fused bodies

prompts.prompt: Manga close-up of Hiro, a 16-year-old boy with messy dark hair, a small cut on his left cheek, school uniform collar open, determined expression, black-and-white screentone shading
prompts.negative_prompt: different hair color, different scar position, blurry eyes, malformed face

prompts.prompt: Manga medium shot of Hiro, same messy dark hair and cut on his left cheek, turning toward a sound in a dark corridor, tense posture, dramatic inking and consistent facial identity
prompts.negative_prompt: new character design, different scar position, extra limbs, blurry face

prompts.prompt: Panel 1 of a manga sequence: a student named Hiro steps onto a windy rooftop at sunset and sees his rival waiting near the fence, wide establishing shot, strong silhouette composition
prompts.negative_prompt: blurry, crowded scene, unreadable background, low contrast
